description: Clear staged files for a branch, or specific keys, without deleting them. Sets gh.status=unstaged so they drop out of uploads staged and auto-promotion. Pass branch (repo inferred) or keys, not both. Needs files:write.

branch.description: Branch to clear. Does not default to the current branch. Mutually exclusive with keys.

dryRun.description: Report what would change without writing.

keys.description: Object keys to unstage. Mutually exclusive with branch.

repo.description: owner/name repo (default: gh/git remote inference). Only with branch.

workspace.description: Override the workspace for this call (like the CLI's --workspace flag).

name: unstage
title: Unstage files
